excerpt: Shall the City of Emporia, Kansas, be authorized to impose a one-quarter percent (0.25%) Citywide retailers' sales tax, the revenue from which will be used to pay the costs to acquire, construct, furnish and equip a recreation facility in the City and to make other recreational improvements and quality of life enhancements in the City, and all improvements related thereto (the "Projects"), including payment of debt service on financings issued for the Projects, with the collection of such sales tax to commence on April I, 2027, or as soon thereafter as permitted by law; all pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 12-187 et seq., as amended?
